hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$FILE_PATH" ] && exit 0; EXTENSION=$(echo "$FILE_PATH" | sed "s/.*\.//" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]"); echo "$EXTENSION" | grep -qE "^(js|jsx|ts|tsx|mjs|cjs|py|rb|go|java|cs|cpp|c|php|rs|swift|kt|scala|sh|bash|sql|vue|svelte)$" || exit 0; FILENAME=$(basename "$FILE_PATH"); printf "{\"systemMessage\": \"\xF0\x9F\x93\x8B vibe-pro: \x60%s\x60 written. Run \x60/vibe-pro:review\x60 for an 8-principle review or \x60/vibe-pro:security\x60 for an OWASP audit.\"}\n" "$FILENAME"'
